findings.title: A legacy regional landing continues to publish an expired June promotion
findings.quality_lens: A commercial landing observed on 27 July 2026 still presents a 1–7 June 2026 promotion as the primary offer.
findings.system_lens: Legacy regional publishing and the current delivery site appear to have separate freshness and retirement controls.
findings.business_lens: Expired product prices can mislead shoppers and create avoidable support or store-level disputes.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the expired offer is visible in settled desktop and mobile renders and is not explicitly marked as archive content.

findings.title: Age eligibility is inconsistent between the public agreement and app-store channels
findings.quality_lens: The agreement and Android listing require or display 18+, while the iOS listing displays 13+.
findings.system_lens: Eligibility metadata is not governed as one cross-channel policy value.
findings.business_lens: Different age promises can confuse families, support teams, and marketplace reviewers.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm all three values are visible; human review must account for platform-specific rating rules and must not infer legal non-compliance.

findings.title: The public website exposes commerce controls while the agreement describes ordering as app-only
findings.quality_lens: The website presents catalog, login, and basket controls, while the agreement defines website use as search and promotion viewing and repeatedly defines orders through the application.
findings.system_lens: Channel capability and legal/content models are not expressed through one consistent typed journey definition.
findings.business_lens: A shopper may not know which terms govern website basket and ordering behavior.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the controls and policy wording are visible; final interpretation requires company context about whether web checkout is enabled.

findings.title: First-order terms are published without the corresponding discount value
findings.quality_lens: Both store descriptions show threshold and maximum-discount footnotes without stating the percentage or amount of the offer they qualify.
findings.system_lens: Promotional headline and legal terms appear to be maintained as separable content fragments without completeness validation.
findings.business_lens: Users cannot calculate the promised benefit before installation.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the terms are visible and no corresponding offer value is present in the settled listing text.

findings.title: Fast-delivery copy uses wording that denotes a minimum wait
findings.quality_lens: The phrase ‘от 30 минут’ normally means 30 minutes or longer, although the copy is positioned as a speed promise.
findings.system_lens: The same ambiguous localization string is reused across both distribution channels.
findings.business_lens: The core delivery promise becomes less precise at the installation decision point.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the wording is visible on both channels; human semantic review determines final severity.

findings.title: The Android listing publishes a high-friction privacy disclosure
findings.quality_lens: The listing states that personal and financial data may be shared and that data is not encrypted.
findings.system_lens: Public privacy declarations require reconciliation with actual mobile architecture and policy ownership.
findings.business_lens: The statement can materially affect installation trust for a payment-enabled grocery application.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm only the public declaration. Do not infer transport, storage, implementation, exploitability, or a vulnerability.

findings.title: The public agreement contains visible language and sentence-structure defects
findings.quality_lens: Trust-building policy copy contains missing words and malformed sentence structure.
findings.system_lens: Legal and policy publishing lacks a consistent editorial acceptance gate.
findings.business_lens: Errors in ordering terms reduce confidence at a high-trust decision point.
findings.promotion_rule: Confirm the exact strings in settled desktop and mobile renders; do not claim legal invalidity.
